title: Standalone explorer shell
responsibility: Hosts the explorer using browser history outside a framework router.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.base
inputs.description: Required explorer URL prefix, removed from the current browser path to initialize the relative route and added back for navigation.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.links
inputs.description: Optional compatibility links, defaulting to an empty list. Forwarded to the console, which currently does not render them.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.exportable
inputs.description: Optional export flag, defaulting to true, forwarded to the console.

outputs.name: HarnessShell
outputs.description: The generic explorer screen inside the console. Browser back and forward update the relative path; console navigation pushes or replaces browser history.
